cases.message: Does Private Browsing hide me from my internet provider?
cases.answer:

cases.message: How do I refresh Firefox?
cases.answer:
To refresh Firefox, select Help from the Firefox Menu bar at the top of the screen on [macOS] or click the menu button and select Help Help and Report on [Windows / Linux]. Choose More troubleshooting information.
Click the Refresh Firefox… button on the right side of the page.
In the confirmation window that appears, click Refresh Firefox.
Firefox will close and restart when it finishes.
When it starts up again, a window will show the data that was imported.
Click Finish.
Choose whether to restore your previous windows and tabs, then click Let’s go!

cases.message: Walk me through exporting my bookmarks to an HTML file
cases.answer:
To export your Firefox bookmarks to an HTML file, follow these steps:
1. Make sure Firefox is up to date.
2. Click the menu button  to open the menu panel.
3. Click Bookmarks and then click the Manage bookmarks bar at the bottom.
4. In the toolbar of the *Library* window click **[macOS]** the  *Import and Backup* button
5. Import and Backup  and choose Export Bookmarks to HTML… from the drop-down menu.
6. In the *Export Bookmarks File* window that opens, choose a location to save the file, which is named bookmarks.html by default.
The desktop is usually a good spot, but any place that is easy to remember will work.
7. Click Save.
The *Export Bookmarks File* window will close.
8. Close the *Library* window.
Your bookmarks are now successfully exported from Firefox.

cases.message: What are the steps to request a refund for Mozilla VPN through the app?
cases.answer:
To request a refund for Mozilla VPN through the app, follow these steps:
1. Open Mozilla VPN and click (or tap) the Settings icon.
2. Scroll down and click (or tap) Help.
3. Click (or tap) Contact support.
4. Fill out the form with your request by completing the following fields:
1. Enter Refund Request in the *Subject (optional)* field.
2. Explain why you are requesting a refund in the *Description of issue* field.
3. For Google Play purchases, please include your Order ID.
5. Click (or tap) the Send button.

cases.message: How do I uninstall Firefox from my computer?
cases.answer:
To uninstall Firefox, follow these steps:
1. Close Firefox (if it is opened): Click the Firefox menu at the top of the screen and select Quit Firefox.
2. Open the Applications folder in Finder on macOS or click the Windows Start button or press the  key to access the Control Panel.
3. In the Control Panel, click the Uninstall a program link under the Programs section.
4. Select Mozilla Firefox from the list of currently installed programs and click the Uninstall button at the top of the list.
5. Click Finish to complete the uninstallation.

cases.message: Can I use Troubleshoot Mode and then refresh if it does not fix things?
cases.answer:
Yes, you can use Troubleshoot Mode and then Refresh Firefox to restore Firefox to its factory default state.
When you choose the 'Refresh Firefox' option in Troubleshoot Mode, your add-ons and other settings will be reset to their default values, but your essential information (such as bookmarks and history) will be saved.

Clearing cookies does not necessarily clear the cache.
To clear the cache alone, go to [Firefox] > Clear cookies for any website, select Privacy & Security > Cookies and Site Data, click Manage browsing data, and uncheck all items except Temporary cached files and pages.

cases.message: What will I lose?
cases.answer:
When refreshing Firefox, you will lose extensions and themes, website permissions, modified preferences, added search engines, DOM storage, security certificate and device settings, download actions, toolbar customizations, and user styles (chrome subfolder containing userChrome and/or userContent CSS files).
You will also save bookmarks, browsing and download history, passwords, cookies, web form autofill information, and personal dictionary.
